17 September 2026

Monetary policy statement

The Governing Council decided today to reduce the three key ECB interest rates by 25 basis points.

Financial conditions

Financing conditions remain tight and continue to transmit to the real economy.

Monetary policy transmission is functioning smoothly.

Inflation

Inflation is expected to be 2.0% by 2027.

Inflation expectations remain firmly anchored.

Risk assessment

Risks are two-sided.

The risks to inflation are balanced.

Closing remarks

The Governing Council will be guided by the incoming data.
